yogas.name: Moon-Mercury Exchange (Parivartana)
yogas.planets: Moon in Gemini (Mercury's sign) + Mercury in Cancer (Moon's sign)
yogas.description: Moon and Mercury exchange signs — emotional intelligence merged with communication. She thinks with her heart and speaks with feeling. Deep emotional understanding expressed through words.

yogas.name: Saturn in Own Sign (Aquarius)
yogas.description: Saturn is strong in its own sign — natural authority in innovation, community, and humanitarian work. Structured approach to future vision.

yogas.name: Venus Debilitated in Virgo
yogas.description: Venus debilitated — love feels constrained, practical, perfectionist. Must learn to accept imperfection in relationships. Service in love heals Venus.

core_strengths: Saturn in own sign (Aquarius) — strong structural authority, innovative discipline
Moon-Mercury exchange — emotional intelligence expressed through communication
Sun in Ashlesha — access to hidden knowledge, kundalini energy, transformative identity
Mercury in Pushya — nourishing communication, teaching ability
core_challenges: Venus debilitated in Virgo — difficulty expressing romantic love freely, perfectionist in relationships
Mars in Taurus — slow to act, stubborn, may resist change
Jupiter in Libra — wisdom through balance, may be indecisive in philosophy
Unknown birth time — house placements unknown
soul_purpose: Emotional nurturing through transformation. Moon-Mercury exchange gives ability to express feelings and nurture through words. Sun in Ashlesha provides access to hidden wisdom. Saturn in Aquarius structures innovation for community service.
family_role: Step-mother. Brings emotional depth (Ashlesha Sun), communication skills (Moon-Mercury exchange), and structural authority (Saturn in Aquarius) to the family. Venus debilitated suggests she shows love through service, not romance.
quranic_connection: Connected to Surah At-Tahrim (66) — purification through family bonds. Also connected to Surah Al-Mujadila (58) — the woman who argued with the Prophet, representing standing up for truth in relationships.
